title: Operational Proto-Introspection in Looped Language Models: Reading Correctness Before the Answer
abstract: arXiv:2607.18553v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can one tell, while a language model reasons, whether its answer will be right? Looped models are a good place to ask: they run the same layers several times per token, leaving one hidden state per loop for a probe to read. I probe Ouro-RLTT, a 2.6B-parameter looped model, for what these states reveal about how its reasoning will end. I call such information operational proto-introspection: operational because it is defined by what a probe can read, and proto because nothing here shows that the model itself uses it.   In part, yes. Reading the first 48 tokens of reasoning, from answers that state no answer yet, a probe on the hidden states reaches an AUROC of 0.758 on a synthetic logic task, against 0.515 for token confidence. Question difficulty is a rival explanation: on 1,164 further questions, token confidence plus simple features of the question predict about as well. translated_title: 循环语言模型中的操作性原初内省：在答案出现之前读取正确性
translated_abstract: 一个人能否在语言模型进行推理的过程中就判断出它的答案是否正确？循环模型是提出这一问题的理想场所：它们对每个token多次重复运行相同的层，每轮循环都会留下一个可供探针读取的隐状态。我对Ouro-RLTT（一个26亿参数的循环模型）进行了探针测试，以了解这些状态能揭示其推理将如何收尾的哪些信息。我将这类信息称为操作性原初内省：之所以称其为“操作性”，是因为它由探针所能读取的内容来定义；之所以称其为“原初”（proto），是因为本文没有任何证据表明模型自身使用了这些信息。在一定程度上，答案是肯定的。在推理尚未给出答案的前48个token上，基于隐状态的探针在一个合成逻辑任务上达到了0.758的AUROC，而token置信度仅为0.515。问题难度是一个竞争性解释：在另外的1,164个问题上，token置信度加上问题的简单特征也能取得相近的预测效果。但这不仅仅是难度：在针对同一问题的两个答案之间……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“操作性原初内省”这一概念，通过探针读取循环语言模型Ouro-RLTT在推理早期的隐状态，证明可以在答案给出之前部分预测推理结果的正确性（AUROC达0.758，远高于token置信度的0.515），并排除了问题难度等竞争性解释。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "operational proto-introspection," showing that a probe reading the looped model Ouro-RLTT's hidden states during early reasoning can partially predict answer correctness before the answer is given (AUROC 0.758 vs. 0.515 for token confidence), while ruling out question difficulty as a rival explanation.
